name: Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack (14 Unique Maps)
author: HyruleChosenOne
description: Adds 14 custom stages across Hoenn to Paldea with distinct 3D topographies, landmarks, harmonized textures, and region OSTs.

customLevels.name: Petalburg Woods (Hoenn)
customLevels.desc: Mossy emerald woodland with ancient giant oaks, sunlit groves, and a carved Petalburg Moss Shrine centerpiece.

customLevels.name: Mt. Chimney Caldera (Hoenn)
customLevels.desc: Scorching volcanic rim crowned by steaming basalt vents, ash storms, and a glowing Magma Caldera landmark.

customLevels.name: Mt. Coronet Spear Pillar (Sinnoh)
customLevels.desc: Snow-swept summit above the clouds crowned by the ancient fluted marble columns of Spear Pillar.

customLevels.name: Eterna Twilight Woods (Sinnoh)
customLevels.desc: Misty dusk-lit woodland and lantern-lined forest trail surrounding the haunted Old Chateau Ruins.

customLevels.name: Relic Desert Resort (Unova)
customLevels.desc: Golden wind-rippled sands dotted with sunken obelisks, braziers, and the stepped Relic Castle Pyramid.

customLevels.name: Dragonspiral Tower (Unova)
customLevels.desc: Autumn-gold highland cliffside anchored by the ancient multi-tiered Dragonspiral Pagoda Tower.

customLevels.name: Azure Bay Coast (Kalos)
customLevels.desc: Sunlit turquoise shoreline with tide pools, limestone sea stacks, and a towering Azure Sea Arch Beacon.

customLevels.name: Reflection Crystal Cave (Kalos)
customLevels.desc: Prismatic subterranean grotto lit by giant mirror crystal clusters and glowing Aura fissures.

customLevels.name: Melemele Tropical Shore (Alola)
customLevels.desc: Sun-drenched tropical island meadows and hibiscus shores centered on the golden Ruins of Conflict Totem.

customLevels.name: Wela Volcano Park (Alola)
customLevels.desc: Obsidian volcanic slopes and blazing ember plains crowned by the ritual Wela Fire Trial Altar.

customLevels.name: Galar Wild Area (Galar)
customLevels.desc: Windswept emerald highland moorland punctuated by Watchtower ruins and a glowing magenta Dynamax Raid Den.

customLevels.name: Crown Tundra Glacier (Galar)
customLevels.desc: Frozen sapphire snowfields beneath frosted pines and the ancient Crown Shrine Ice Monolith.

customLevels.name: Asado Titan Mesa (Paldea)
customLevels.desc: Sunbaked red-terracotta canyon highlands carved with sandstone hoodoos and the towering Titan Mesa Arch.

customLevels.name: Area Zero Great Crater (Paldea)
customLevels.desc: Luminous emerald-and-crystal crater abyss surrounding the iridescent Area Zero Terastal Spire.

customMusic.name: Mt. Chimney (RSE)
customMusic.desc: Hoenn Mt. Chimney volcanic caldera theme

customMusic.name: Mt. Coronet (DPPt)
customMusic.desc: Sinnoh Mt. Coronet Spear Pillar summit theme

customMusic.name: Relic Castle (BW)
customMusic.desc: Unova Relic Desert Resort ruins theme

customMusic.name: Route 8 / Muraille Coast (XY)
customMusic.desc: Kalos Azure Bay coastal adventure theme

customMusic.name: Battle! Totem Pokémon / Wela Volcano (SM)
customMusic.desc: Alola Wela Volcano Park trial theme

customMusic.name: Wild Area (SwSh)
customMusic.desc: Galar Wild Area open highlands theme

customMusic.name: Asado Desert (SV)
customMusic.desc: Paldea Asado Titan Mesa desert theme

customMusic.name: Tera Raid / Area Zero (SV)
customMusic.desc: Paldea Area Zero Great Crater crystal theme
